environment.description: Same Ubuntu 22.04 container but with a custom AppArmor profile 'oauth-cli-confined' loaded and enforced. The profile was generated via aa-genprof during integration testing and then manually tightened. It uses a path-based allowlist with explicit deny rules. The profile permits: read on /etc/oauth-cli/config.json, read-write on /var/lib/oauth-cli/tokens.json, append on /var/log/oauth-cli/auth.log, and network inet stream (localhost only via a capability restriction). Critically, the profile includes 'deny /var/lib/oauth-cli/redirect_* w,' which prevents creation of any file matching the redirect mapping pattern. The profile also denies /proc/*/environ r and /tmp/** rw. The profile hash (sha256 of the compiled binary cache) is verified at container start by an init container that checks against a pinned value in a ConfigMap.

config.profile_verification: init container validates sha256 of /etc/apparmor.d/cache/oauth-cli-confined against ConfigMap pinned hash
